title: Estée Lauder Companies partners with Microsoft to boost AI capabilities
summary: The move forms part of the Estée Lauder Companies’ efforts to bring together its global operations under a single operating model, and will advance the MAC Cosmetics and Clinique owner’s artificial intelligence, cloud and data capabilities

extraction.key_fact: Estée Lauder Companies가 Microsoft와 손잡고 인공지능과 클라우드 역량을 키운다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The move forms part of the Estée Lauder Companies’ efforts to bring together its global operations under a single operating model, and will advance the MAC Cosmetics and Clinique owner’s artificial intelligence, cloud and data capabilities
